# apparent brand guidelines full context

> Canonical compact context for agents creating apparent writing, design, product interfaces, and frontend code. Always spell apparent in lowercase.

## Non-negotiable rules

- Write `apparent`, never a capitalized or uppercase form.
- Use `tryapparent` as the consistent unique handle on LinkedIn, GitHub, social
  accounts, package scopes, and similar services.
- Never use em dashes.
- Use Host Grotesk and the approved five-color system.
- Signal marks one active or decisive workflow thread, including an
  in-progress state, related primary action, focus, selection, or transition.
- Keep source evidence attached to claims, metrics, extracted values, and human
  decisions.
- Label estimates, forecasts, illustrative examples, limitations, timeframes,
  and sources.
- Safety, privacy, product semantics, and WCAG 2.2 AA override visual fidelity.

## Foundations

Category: AI-ready operational data.
Company: the operational-data platform for AI-native companies.
Promise: Operational data you can build on.
Proposition: Documents ready for AI.
Character: lean, fast, technical, assured, precise.

## Visual system

Paper `#F5F0E8` is the reading surface. Stock `#E7E0EE` groups structure. Carbon
`#020102` is ink and the inverse field. Lilac `#B7A5D8` marks selection and
depth. Signal `#7A58C7` marks one decisive action or transition.

Normal-size Signal text is allowed only on Paper. On Stock or Carbon, use
Signal for non-text UI, focus, graphics, large text, or filled controls with
Paper text. Signal and Lilac always need a second distinction such as a label,
shape, pattern, position, or outline.

The wordmark color field is the primary highlighter device. It represents
structure revealed inside a document. Lilac may mark source evidence, extracted
fields, selected regions, and information that has become structured. Signal
marks one decisive action or transition. Highlights stay rectangular, close to
the content they explain, and sparse.

Use supplied boxed wordmarks and icons without rebuilding, cropping, stretching,
effects, or unapproved colors. Wordmark clear space is 0.5 times the complete
color-box height. Its digital minimum is 120px wide. Icon clear space is 0.5
times its width. Its digital minimum is 24 by 24px.

Host Grotesk weights are 400, 500, and 700. Presentation type is 120 / 60 / 30.
Product type is 36 / 18 / 16. Reserve 16px for short companion metadata. Body,
controls, labels, validation, and critical status remain 18px or larger.

Use an 8px spacing base, 12 desktop columns, 24px gutters, 32px desktop content
inset, square corners, 1px Carbon rules, and visible Signal focus. Motion lasts
120 to 200ms only when it explains a real state change. Respect reduced motion.

### Functional status colors

- Success `#146B43`: completed, confirmed, delivered, or healthy.
- In progress `#7A58C7`: processing, retrying, queued, or incomplete; aliases Signal.
- Warning `#FFBE2E`: preventive caution before failure; use Carbon text on gold.
- Failure `#B42318`: failed, unavailable, invalid, blocked, or action required.
- Destructive `#B42318`: destructive action with explicit confirmation.
- Disabled: Carbon at 45% emphasis on disabled controls only, with native
  disabled semantics. Informative text remains readable Carbon.

These are functional semantics, not brand accents. Pair every status with a
written label and icon, outline, pattern, or shape. Default to light fields with
strong bars or icons and reserve solid fields for actions and escalation.
Failure and destructive share a hue but retain separate semantic roles.

## Data visualization

Charts make the relationship and evidence status auditable. Require the metric,
unit, denominator, time window, local time zone, source, refresh time, assumptions,
status, and uncertainty where applicable. Label actual, estimate, forecast,
modeled, and illustrative data explicitly.

Use aligned bars or dots for comparison, time series for trends, ranges or
thresholds for uncertainty, and named stages for process or funnel views. Use
direct labels, exact values, truthful proportions, and shared baselines. A
tooltip is supplementary. Provide a concise text summary and an accessible
table or equivalent data view.

Display time in the user's or operation's local zone and name the zone
explicitly, for example `09:42 CEST`. Use UTC only for technical logs or
genuinely cross-region coordination. Do not expose UTC merely because the
backend stores it.

LayerChart 2 is the single chart engine behind locally owned apparent chart
components. shadcn-svelte chart source is optional scaffolding, not a visual
authority. Carbon establishes axes and baselines, Lilac provides comparison
structure, and Signal selects one series or threshold. The approved
multi-series system is core plus pattern and adds no categorical hues. Use
Signal solid for one selected series, Lilac and Carbon for comparisons, then
repeat Lilac and Carbon only with direct labels plus distinct dash, pattern, or
outline. Keep no more than five visible series. Filter, group, use small
multiples, change the chart, or provide a table instead of adding colors.

Do not use decorative 3D treatments, decorative or value-encoding gradients,
unlabeled axes, color-matching legends, or library-default palettes. CSS
gradient functions may render approved hatch or dot patterns only. Pair color
with a text, line, pattern, outline, or other non-color cue.

## Writing system

Lead with the fact. Name the actor and action. Use short concrete words. Cut
words that do no work. Keep one claim per sentence. Attach proof, source,
timeframe, and evidence status. Use active voice, sentence case, periods, and
European dates in `DD.MM.YYYY` format with 24-hour time.

Avoid magic, seamless, revolutionary, game-changing, unlock the power of,
unsupported claims, exclamation marks, slogan stacks, decorative Unicode type,
and invented evidence.

## Identifiers

Canonical IDs use `<lowercase-prefix>_<uppercase-ULID>`, for example
`run_01JQ7M6J8H9T2R4K5N6P7Q8S9T`. Approved prefixes are `doc_`, `run_`, `bat_`,
`rev_`, and `out_`. IDs are immutable, opaque, never recycled, free of personal
data, and separate from authorization. Reprocessing creates a new `run_`.

## Frontend system

Use semantic HTML first. Use ARIA only when native semantics cannot express the
interaction. For Svelte 5 and SvelteKit products, Bits UI is the single
component-library dependency. shadcn-svelte is an optional source recipe
catalogue, not a second runtime component system. Generated recipes become
locally owned apparent components. LayerChart 2 is the single chart engine and
remains behind local apparent chart components. apparent tokens are the visual
authority. The preserved Flask and Bootstrap portal is legacy evidence only.

Do not keep duplicate Bits UI and shadcn-svelte versions of a component. Do not
add another primitive library, chart engine, icon system, or theme without a
documented unmet requirement. Do not adopt upstream colors, typography, radii,
shadows, card layouts, motion, or chart palettes.

Every component documents purpose, anatomy, input methods, focus order, default,
hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty, error, success, partial, and retrying
states where relevant, responsive behavior, accessible name and announcements,
privacy boundaries, and tests.

Use an ordinary section title without decorative `01` or `02` prefixes. Number
only genuine ordered steps. Time-based result and activity lists default to
most recent first, expose the active sort, and may be reversed. Priority or SLA
queues may use a clearly labeled urgency order instead.

Prefer relative time when recency is the user's main question. Keep the exact
local date, time, and named zone available in accessible detail. Use absolute
local time for schedules, deadlines, audit trails, exports, older records, and
precise comparison.

Support keyboard-complete operation, visible focus, 200% text resize, 320 CSS px
reflow, text-spacing overrides, reduced motion, and screen-reader names. Target
44 by 44 CSS pixels for primary controls. Do not rely on color alone.

Keep durable state on the server and use progressive enhancement for essential
workflows where the product architecture allows it. Long-running actions return
a stable prefixed ULID and status link. Never fabricate progress. Escape
untrusted content, protect writes against CSRF, and keep private document data
out of URLs, logs, analytics, notifications, and browser persistence.

## Open decisions

Print color specifications, co-branding, and final responsive type values remain
unresolved. Functional status tokens and the core-plus-pattern chart system are
approved. Do not invent additional roles or chart hues.
